stem.text: Which row shows a comparison that is **not** correct between a typical prokaryotic cell and a typical eukaryotic plant cell?

A.text: DNA not associated with histones; DNA associated with histones

B.text: no endoplasmic reticulum present; endoplasmic reticulum present

C.text: peptidoglycan cell walls; cellulose cell walls

D.text: all ribosomes approximately 18 nm in diameter; all ribosomes approximately 22 nm in diameter

D:
all ribosomes approximately
18 nm in diameter

all ribosomes approximately
22 nm in diameter
